# Wavefront Academy — Machine-Readable Institution Profile

> Wavefront Academy is a premier coaching institute based in Virar East, Palghar District, Maharashtra, India. It specializes in competitive entrance examination coaching (JEE Mains & Advanced, NEET-UG, MHT-CET) and school & junior college academics (8th to 10th SSC/CBSE/ICSE and 11th & 12th Science HSC/CBSE).

## Core Facts & Identity
- **Legal & Operating Name**: Wavefront Academy
- **Official Website**: https://wavefrontacademy.web.app
- **Physical Address**: Shop No. 11, Maitry Pooja Apartment, Near Manvelpada Talav, Virar East, Maharashtra 401303, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude 19.4425421, Longitude 72.8200961
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 70581 07207
- **Official Email**: wavefrontacademy07@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 08:00 AM – 09:00 PM IST

## Verified Programs Offered
1. **JEE Mains & Advanced**: Rigorous coaching for engineering aspirants with conceptual Physics, Chemistry, and Advanced Mathematics, NTA-pattern mock tests, and regular doubt sessions.
2. **NEET-UG**: Medical entrance coaching with line-by-line NCERT Biology emphasis, Physics numerical speed drills, Chemistry question banks, and OMR tests.
3. **MHT-CET (Engineering & Pharmacy)**: Specialized preparation based on the Maharashtra State Board textbook curriculum, shortcut problem-solving techniques, and online Computer-Based Test (CBT) simulations.
4. **11th & 12th Science**: Comprehensive board coaching (PCM & PCB) covering Maharashtra State Board (HSC) and CBSE curriculum.
5. **Class 8th, 9th & 10th Foundation**: Concept-first coaching for Maharashtra SSC, CBSE, and ICSE boards to establish solid foundations for high-school board exams and competitive exams.
6. **Other Competitive Exams**: Guidance for NDA (National Defence Academy), IMU-CET (Merchant Navy), and B.Sc Nursing entrance tests.

## Teaching Methodology & Distinctions
- **Small Batch Sizes**: Ensuring personalized attention and immediate doubt resolution.
- **Continuous Evaluation**: Weekly chapter-end tests and full-syllabus preliminary mock exams with transparent parent reporting.
- **Strategic Location**: Located right near Manvelpada Talav in Virar East, highly accessible by auto-rickshaw from Virar Railway Station (East).
